assertions.description: U1 is a TI LMP8640 high-side current shunt monitor (lib: Amplifier_Current:LMP8640). R2 (4.99Ω) is the shunt resistor connected across U1's + (pin 3) and - (pin 4) differential inputs. This is a canonical current-sense circuit — the IC is explicitly classed as a current amplifier and the shunt is directly across its sense inputs. The analyzer reports 0 current_sense detections. The subcircuits section correctly identifies U1 with neighbors R1, R2, JP1, J2 but does not classify the function. A current_sense detection should be generated for U1/R2.
